messages:
incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem 'stream-worker-failures' action item #3 (owner: @nate) is 8 days overdue. Please update status or reassign. Tracker: https://redwood.company/pm/stream-worker-failures/actions :bell:
nate: Apologies — been triaging regressions. Blocked on adding the new telemetry counter and a short-lived feature flag for staged rollout. WIP PR, awaiting infra review.
eva: @nate can you share the PR link and the minimal test output? We need to know if it's safe to flip the flag in prod.
nate: PR: https://git.redwood/stream/pulls/256. Test snippet:
``narrow: telemetry.counter.worker_restart_total increased from 0 -> 4 under load test``n
mika_oncall: If restart_total > 3 in 10m we currently auto-evict the pod. That made last week's incident worse. We should avoid auto-evict until this telemetry is tuned.
product-ops: This is blocking the streaming SLA work. If not resolved by EOD tomorrow we need to escalate and notify customers.
infra: Reviewing the PR now. One request: make the flag configurable per-cluster so we can canary in region-y first.
nate: I'll add per-cluster flag. ETA: +1 business day. Moving status to 'in-progress' in tracker.
incident-bot: Reminder set: follow up in 24h with @nate.
(24h later)
nate: Update: added per-cluster flag, merged, and canaried in region-y. Telemetry shows worker_restart_total stable at 0-1; no evictions.
eva: Can you add a short mitigation note in the postmortem describing the temporary disable of auto-evict on worker restarts?
nate: Done. Also added a dashboard panel for restart_total and an alert: worker_restart_total > 3 for 10m.
mika_oncall: Will monitor. If alerts fire, we escalate to infra.
(48h later)
nate: No alerts. Canary promoted to 50% then 100%. Action #3 marked done in tracker.
product-ops: Closing action and tagging the postmortem 'recurring-pattern'. Scheduling a follow-up for the reliability review.
nate: Left root cause note: race during shutdown + unhandled transient error. Fix: graceful shutdown + telemetry + per-cluster rollout flag. Closing my loop. :white_check_mark:
